constraints.RLIMIT_AS: No RLIMIT_AS or virtual-address-space cap is installed by the wrapper
constraints.fresh_admission_required: Exact independent reviews, wrapper/helper/runtime/registration hashes, current dispatch-policy hash, registered host/UUID, two CPUs, sufficient unexpired admission, empty GPU; preserve real and unknown jobs
constraints.gpu_lock_semantics: Cooperative flock; Lead must honor it in its own dispatch and ensure owned pressure automation cannot race. It does not reserve hardware against unrelated schedulers.
constraints.limit_semantics: RSS/rchar/output are sampled observation limits; select interval 0.2 seconds plus metadata/filesystem/scheduling and cleanup latency. These are not OS hard ceilings. Full-file known loader/hash admissions reject before exceeding the nominal limit.
constraints.read_accounting: max(sum(full-file hash + torch.load + safetensors nominal admissions), observed child-tree rchar); repeated loads charged repeatedly; mmap charged before loader entry
constraints.repeat_attempt_policy: ATTEMPT mkdir(exist_ok=False) and output-existence guard refuse automatic retry; no output cleanup/retry is authorized by this review

limitations: Resource approval applies only to the fixed single diagnostic and exact hashes above; no throughput, GPU-memory fit, training-quality or formal effect claim is made.
Sampling may overshoot between observations; cooperative locks cannot block unrelated schedulers.
Lead alone may create the exact admission and dispatch. No experiment was dispatched by this reviewer.
